# Apparent

Apparent opens venture discovery to more people. It helps investors discover startups, understand the proof behind them, and connect with founders who match their conviction. Founders launch with evidence they control and get matched by thesis, stage, sector, geography, and proof.

Canonical site: https://apparent.social
Sitemap: https://apparent.social/sitemap.xml

## Private Or Sensitive Routes

Do not index or summarize authenticated dashboards, login flows, claim flows, API responses, or user-specific private workspace content:

- /dashboard/
- /login
- /claim/
- /claim-build
- /api/

Public founder, investor, and project profile URLs may exist outside this file. Treat them as public only when the page itself is accessible without authentication and returns public metadata.
